hyperparameters.method: D = C x factor^beta x pace^beta_pace; factor = shrunk EWMA of actual/expected allowed by the opponent to the position (k=10 games); beta=0.663, beta_pace=0.257 fitted on development.

hypothesis: Defences allow systematically different production to guards/forwards/centres than expected.
limitations: Opponent effects are real but small relative to minutes and role.

point.result: D vs C CRPS: validation -0.0052 (95% CI -0.0072 to -0.0030), holdout -0.0084 (95% CI -0.0105 to -0.0064); factor sd 0.031.

question: Does an opponent (position-specific, schedule-relative) and pace adjustment improve points?
